name: Vinpai SAS
summary: Headquartered in Saint-Dolay, France, Vinpai SAS, founded in 2011, is a company dedicated to the development, production, and distribution of functional ingredients. These ingredients are sourced from natural elements like algae, plants, minerals, and fibers, and are primarily utilized as natural alternatives to synthetic chemical additives. The company's offerings span a broad range of industries, including food, cosmetics, well-being, and health. Within the food industry, Vinpai provides diverse solutions, from plant-based alternatives for dairy, cheese, and flavorings, to technical applications like texturizing agents, salt reduction solutions, and ingredients for meat applications. Their products support various food items such as plant-based cheeses, dairy products, dressing sauces, fries, and sweet treats. For the food supplementation, well-being, and health sectors, their portfolio includes unique marine-derived components such as sulfated polysaccharides, essential trace elements, amino acids, fiber-rich ingredients, and unsaturated fatty acids, alongside algarotherapy ingredients. In cosmetics, they supply algae-mineral based ingredients for products like peel-off masks, as well as various active compounds. Furthermore, Vinpai develops algae-origin medical devices, including alginate patches and molding powders for aesthetic and dental hygiene applications.
